立即切换并自动保存，下次启动继续使用。: Changes apply immediately and are saved for next time.
只改变界面语言，录音、转录、笔记和 System Prompt 保持原样。: This changes the interface only. Recordings, transcripts, notes and the System Prompt stay as saved.

一份录音，一次值得回顾的学习。: Turn a lecture recording into something worth revisiting.

与 Java 后端共享同一个 DATA_DIR: Must share DATA_DIR with the Java service

从课堂声音到清晰笔记，把时间留给理解。: Turn lectures into clear notes, with more time to understand.
你的第一份课堂笔记，从这里开始: Your first lecture note starts here

创建官方 Integration，并在目标数据库的连接菜单中授权。: Create an official Notion integration and connect it to your database.

单数据源数据库可留空: Optional for databases with one data source

可选，与 Worker 环境变量保持一致: Optional; must match the Worker environment

听见课堂，读懂知识: Hear the lecture. Understand the ideas.
告诉它改哪里、保留什么。修改自动保存新版本，可在「版本」中恢复。: Say what to change and what to keep. Revisions are saved as new versions, which you can restore from History.

好笔记的起点，是认真听过的每一堂课。: Good notes begin with a lecture worth listening to.

整理知识，留下思考。按课程与日期回顾每一次学习。: Organize ideas and revisit each lecture by course and date.

本次修改未完成，当前笔记保留。: This revision did not finish. The current note is preserved.
查询目标数据库。若已有页面，稍后重试会复用；仅在确认没有页面时重置，避免重复。: in the target database. A retry will reuse an existing page. Reset only after confirming there is no page, to avoid duplicates.
